# Ensure month column is datetime
df["CLAIM_MONTH_DT"] = pd.to_datetime(df["CLAIM_FROM_MONTH"], format="%Y-%m")

# Aggregate total paid by month
monthly_paid = (
    df.groupby("CLAIM_MONTH_DT", as_index=False)["TOTAL_PAID"]
      .sum()
      .sort_values("CLAIM_MONTH_DT")
)

# Convert to billions
monthly_paid["TOTAL_PAID_B"] = monthly_paid["TOTAL_PAID"] / 1e9

sns.set_style("white")
plt.figure(figsize=(11, 5))
ax = sns.lineplot(
    data=monthly_paid,
    x="CLAIM_MONTH_DT",
    y="TOTAL_PAID_B",
    marker="o",
    linewidth=2
)

ax.set_title("Total Medicaid Paid per Month")
ax.set_xlabel("Claim Month")
ax.set_ylabel("Total Paid (Billions USD)")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda y, _: f"${y:.1f}B"))
ax.grid(False)

# Clear, readable monthly timeline
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.MonthLocator(interval=2))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%Y-%m"))

# Visualization standards: no extra edge gaps and zero baseline
x_min = monthly_paid["CLAIM_MONTH_DT"].min()
x_max = monthly_paid["CLAIM_MONTH_DT"].max()
y_max = monthly_paid["TOTAL_PAID_B"].max()
ax.set_xlim(x_min, x_max)
ax.set_ylim(0, y_max * 1.05)
ax.margins(x=0, y=0)

plt.xticks(rotation=90, ha="right")
sns.despine(ax=ax)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Monthly aggregates
monthly = (
    df.groupby("CLAIM_FROM_MONTH", as_index=False)
      .agg(
          TOTAL_CLAIMS=("TOTAL_CLAIMS", "sum"),
          TOTAL_PAID=("TOTAL_PAID", "sum")
      )
)

monthly["CLAIM_MONTH_DT"] = pd.to_datetime(monthly["CLAIM_FROM_MONTH"], format="%Y-%m")
monthly = monthly.sort_values("CLAIM_MONTH_DT")

# Scale units: claims -> millions, paid -> billions
monthly["TOTAL_CLAIMS_M"] = monthly["TOTAL_CLAIMS"] / 1e6
monthly["TOTAL_PAID_B"] = monthly["TOTAL_PAID"] / 1e9

# Regression in scaled units
X = monthly[["TOTAL_CLAIMS_M"]].to_numpy()
y = monthly["TOTAL_PAID_B"].to_numpy()

model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)
r_squared = model.score(X, y)

# Plot
x_line = np.linspace(X.min(), X.max(), 200).reshape(-1, 1)
y_line = model.predict(x_line)

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(X.ravel(), y, alpha=0.8)
plt.plot(x_line, y_line, color="red", linewidth=2)

plt.title(f"Monthly Aggregate Regression (R²={r_squared:.3f})")
plt.xlabel("Monthly Total Claims (Millions)")
plt.ylabel("Monthly Total Paid (Billions USD)")
plt.gca().xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v:.0f}M"))
plt.gca().yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"${v:.1f}B"))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

sns.set_style("white")
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

numeric_cols = [
    "TOTAL_UNIQUE_BENEFICIARIES",
    "TOTAL_CLAIMS",
    "TOTAL_PAID",
    "AVG_CLAIMS_PER_PATIENT",
    "AVG_PAYMENT_AMT",
    "AVG_PAID_PER_BENEFICIARY",
]

dollar_cols = {"TOTAL_PAID", "AVG_PAYMENT_AMT", "AVG_PAID_PER_BENEFICIARY"}
MAX_POINTS = 1_000_000

def fmt_for(col):
    if col in dollar_cols:
        return FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"${x:,.0f}")
    if col == "AVG_CLAIMS_PER_PATIENT":
        return FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:,.2f}")
    return FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:,.0f}")

# --- Untrimmed version (full valid values) ---
fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(numeric_cols), 2, figsize=(14, 3.2 * len(numeric_cols)))

for i, col in enumerate(numeric_cols):
    x = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").to_numpy(dtype=np.float32, copy=False)
    vals = x[np.isfinite(x)]

    if vals.size > MAX_POINTS:
        vals = vals[rng.choice(vals.size, size=MAX_POINTS, replace=False)]

    tag = f"N={vals.size:,.0f}"

    # Histogram
    ax = axes[i, 0]
    if vals.size:
        ax.hist(vals, bins=60, color="#4C78A8", alpha=0.9)
    else:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No valid values", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.set_title(f"{col} Distribution (untrimmed, sampled)")
    ax.set_xlabel(col)
    ax.set_ylabel("Count")
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(fmt_for(col))
    ax.text(0.98, 0.95, tag, transform=ax.transAxes, ha="right", va="top", fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(False)
    sns.despine(ax=ax)

    # Boxplot
    ax = axes[i, 1]
    if vals.size:
        ax.boxplot(
            vals,
            vert=False,
            showfliers=False,  # keep False for rendering speed
            whis=(0, 100),
            patch_artist=True,
            boxprops=dict(facecolor="#72B7B2"),
        )
    else:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No valid values", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.set_title(f"{col} Boxplot (untrimmed, sampled)")
    ax.set_xlabel(col)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(fmt_for(col))
    ax.text(0.98, 0.95, tag, transform=ax.transAxes, ha="right", va="top", fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(False)
    sns.despine(ax=ax)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

sns.set_style("white")
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

numeric_cols = [
    "TOTAL_UNIQUE_BENEFICIARIES",
    "TOTAL_CLAIMS",
    "TOTAL_PAID",
    "AVG_CLAIMS_PER_PATIENT",
    "AVG_PAYMENT_AMT",
    "AVG_PAID_PER_BENEFICIARY",
]

dollar_cols = {"TOTAL_PAID", "AVG_PAYMENT_AMT", "AVG_PAID_PER_BENEFICIARY"}
MAX_POINTS = 1_000_000

def fmt_for(col):
    if col in dollar_cols:
        return FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"${x:,.0f}")
    if col == "AVG_CLAIMS_PER_PATIENT":
        return FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:,.2f}")
    return FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f"{x:,.0f}")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(numeric_cols), 2, figsize=(14, 3.2 * len(numeric_cols)))

for i, col in enumerate(numeric_cols):
    x = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce").to_numpy(dtype=np.float32, copy=False)
    x = x[np.isfinite(x)]

    if x.size == 0:
        q10, q90 = np.nan, np.nan
        vals = np.array([], dtype=np.float32)
        kept_pct = np.nan
    else:
        q10, q90 = np.quantile(x, [0.10, 0.90])
        vals = x[(x >= q10) & (x <= q90)]
        kept_pct = 100 * vals.size / x.size

    if vals.size > MAX_POINTS:
        vals = vals[rng.choice(vals.size, size=MAX_POINTS, replace=False)]

    if np.isfinite(q10):
        tag = f"P10={q10:,.2f}, P90={q90:,.2f}, kept={kept_pct:.1f}%"
    else:
        tag = "No valid values"

    # Histogram
    ax = axes[i, 0]
    if vals.size:
        ax.hist(vals, bins=60, color="#4C78A8", alpha=0.9)
    else:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No values after trimming", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.set_title(f"{col} Distribution (P10-P90, sampled)")
    ax.set_xlabel(col)
    ax.set_ylabel("Count")
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(fmt_for(col))
    ax.text(0.98, 0.95, tag, transform=ax.transAxes, ha="right", va="top", fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(False)
    sns.despine(ax=ax)

    # Boxplot
    ax = axes[i, 1]
    if vals.size:
        ax.boxplot(
            vals,
            vert=False,
            showfliers=False,
            whis=(0, 100),
            patch_artist=True,
            boxprops=dict(facecolor="#72B7B2"),
        )
    else:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No values after trimming", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
    ax.set_title(f"{col} Boxplot (P10-P90, sampled)")
    ax.set_xlabel(col)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(fmt_for(col))
    ax.text(0.98, 0.95, tag, transform=ax.transAxes, ha="right", va="top", fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(False)
    sns.despine(ax=ax)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
